concept: The launch card is the product: it splits into feature tiles on the beat and folds back into the brand lockup.

beatMap.lands: The card drops on the downbeat; the brand, headline, and subhead land on their accents; the NEW badge pulses on beats 2 and 3.
The card folds to one row and the three feature tiles cut out of it on beats 4, 5.5, and 7; the bar ticks fill on each beat.
The tile numbers flash in turn on each beat while the names hold; a riser builds.
Strongest impact on beat 12: the tiles fold into the accent panel and the lockup lands; the CTA opens on 12.5 and its arrow nudges; everything leaves on the last eighth.

handoffs.element: The card folds into the first feature tile.
The tiles fold back into the first row, which opens into the accent panel.

sound.concept: A 128 BPM drop: each feature tile is a pluck that cuts out of the card, and the lockup is the impact.

cueMap.kick: The bar ticks fill on every beat.
cueMap.impact: Beat 12: the panel opens into the lockup.
cueMap.riser: Beats 8-12: the tile numbers flash in turn.
cueMap.point1: Each tile cuts out on its pluck.
cueMap.cta: The CTA words land on lead notes.

findings.issue: Template literals in the inline scripts failed HyperFrames strict lint.
findings.fix: The runtime bundle and template scripts use plain string concatenation.

findings.issue: top and height tweens stuttered under frame capture.
findings.fix: All moves use transforms and clip-path insets.

findings.issue: The final exits ran past 7.5 s, so the loop broke.
findings.fix: Exits start on the last eighth; the runtime now fails if any tween ends after the score.

findings.issue: The subhead held for only 6 frames, and the max-length lockup brand clipped.
findings.fix: The card scene was re-slotted so the subhead lands on beat 1.5; the lockup brand fits down to 52 px.

approval.waiver: Operator approved shipping to test the mix in production.
